purpose: Teach: 金儲け/とことん/さりげ/ガンガン/ハゲ/音量/見物/ねらい

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんは金儲けより道徳を大事にされたぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father was young, he valued integrity far more than profit.
lines.style: Soft, nostalgic opening. Long pause between phrases, as if reaching back through decades. Quiet reverence—not performing, but genuinely moved by the memory. Voice settles lower on 'integrity.'

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん、お祖父ちゃん、何事もとことん追求されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: Yes, and you pursued everything so thoroughly, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Warm affirmation, almost singing the words. Gentle tease underneath—she's known him fifty years and still finds it endearing. Soft upturn at the end, inviting agreement, not challenging.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、お父さんのさりげないお気遣いに感動したぞ
lines.en: Gran, it was the small, thoughtless kindnesses from your father that moved me most.
lines.style: Voice fractures slightly on 'small'—emotion just beneath the surface. Slower pace. Each phrase deliberate, like he's still discovering what those kindnesses meant. Trailing off into quiet wonder.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、お孫さんとガンガン遊ばれたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You played so hard with your grandchildren, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Playful lilt, almost teasing. She's remembering him breathless and laughing. Light, affectionate—the sound of a wife who watched her husband become a grandfather. Bright at 'played,' warm at the end.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、お父さんのハゲた頭、ばあさんはお優しく見守られたぞ
lines.en: Gran, I watched you care for your father so gently—even as age took its toll on him.
lines.style: Soft, almost whispered. Reverence mixed with quiet grief. Long inhale before speaking, as if gathering the weight of that tenderness. His voice thins on 'gently,' protecting something precious.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、テレビの音量を絞ってお話されたわよね、あなた?
lines.en: And you lowered the television so we could talk, didn't you, dear?
lines.style: Intimate, recognizing a quiet sacrifice. Not loud—almost conspiratorial, like she's telling him a secret he already knows. Soft smile in the voice. Slight emphasis on 'talk,' as if that mattered most.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: ばあさん、若い頃、田植えの見物に村人が集まったぞ
lines.en: Gran, when your father planted rice, the whole village came to watch.
lines.style: Admiring, steady voice. Not boastful—factual, but filled with quiet pride. Pause after 'father,' letting the image settle. Calm, observational tone, like he can still see it clearly.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お祖父ちゃん、商売のねらいを若い私に語ってくださったわよね、あなた?
lines.en: You taught me about business when I was young, sharing your knowledge so freely, dear.
lines.style: Grateful, wondering tone. She's still thinking about those conversations. Voice warm but slightly tentative—like she's still processing how much he trusted her. Close and intimate, almost whispering the gratitude.
